verdict.rationale: Omnirush is a desktop app for working with a coding agent on your own projects. It can clone and work with repos, but the evidence never mentions creating a shared team workspace built from docs and repos as a common source of truth. Team or shared knowledge workspaces are a fair axis for this kind of product, so the lack of evidence makes this none rather than na.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can create a shared workspace from my docs and repos as a common source of truth for the team
